channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Former Sunday Game presenter Michael Lyster passes away
item.description: Michael Lyster, the long-time presenter of RTE's 'Sunday Game' programme, has died at the age of 71.

item.title: Donegal and Kerry to battle it out at Croker again as Dubs relegated in Salthill
item.description: Donegal and Kerry will meet in next Sunday's Allianz Football League Division 1 final at Croke Park (4pm) following this afternoon's seventh round results.

item.title: Fixtures confirmed for Allianz Football League finals
item.description: The GAA has confirmed the fixtures for next weekend's Allianz Football League finals following today's seventh round results.

item.title: Joyce relieved as Galway finish with a flourish
item.description: Padraic Joyce cut a relieved figure after Galway retained their Allianz Football League Division 1 status and relegated Dublin.

item.title: Cleary 'absolutely thrilled' to secure promotion
item.description: John Cleary was delighted after Cork defeated Tyrone to earn promotion to Division 1 of the Allianz Football League for the first time since 2016.

item.title: 'Unimaginable heartbreak' at Tyrone mascot's passing
item.description: Tributes have been pouring in following the passing of an eight-year-old Tyrone GAA mascot over the weekend.

item.title: McGuinness disappointed with Donegal defending
item.description: Jim McGuinness was disappointed with Donegal's defending in their 3-20 to 3-16 victory over an already-relegated Monaghan.

item.title: Moran pleased with newcomers as Mayo sign off in style
item.description: Andy Moran was happy to be able to hand out five debuts as an experimental Mayo completed their Allianz Football League Division 1 campaign with a 21-point rout of an even more experimental Roscommon in Castlebar.

item.title: Brennan regrets 'silly' red card
item.description: Ger Brennan has admitted that he deserved to be sent off during Dublin's Allianz Football League defeat to Galway.

item.title: Sadness at passing of Dublin LGFA secretary Mary O'Connor
item.description: Dublin LGFA is in mourning following the passing of Mary O'Connor after a long battle with illness bravely borne.

item.title: Funeral arrangements for Michael Lyster
item.description: Funeral details have been announced for the much-loved broadcaster Michael Lyster, who passed away on Saturday at the age of 71.

item.title: McGrath: Hurling League finals should be in Croker
item.description: Shane McGrath maintains that the Allianz Hurling Division 1A and 1B finals should be played in Croke Park.

item.title: Langan and O'Donnell appointed Donegal joint-captains
item.description: Michael Langan and Shane O'Donnell have been named as joint-captains of the Donegal senior football team.

item.title: Relegation 'not the end of the world' for Dubs
item.description: Ger Brennan doesn't see relegation to Division 2 of the Allianz Football League as a setback for Dublin.

item.title: Only 141 attended Tipp-Waterford football clash
item.description: FBD Semple Stadium hosted one of its smallest ever crowds when just 141 spectators passed through the turnstiles for last Sunday's Allianz Football League Division 4 clash between Tipperary and Waterford.
